newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senator Lautenberg sees budget problems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senator Lautenberg sees budget problems.

text.p: The top-ranking Democrat on the Senate Budget Committee said Monday he was worried about prospects of reaching a balanced budget deal but continued to be hopeful this week's talks would be successful.
"Based on progress made to date, it doesn't look like we are even inching upward on it (budget agreement)," he told reporters at the start of this week's talks.
Asked to describe his feelings on the process, he replied, "Worry, worry, worry."
"There is a sincere belief we can move this thing along and I am hopeful," the New Jersey senator added.
